scholarships.title: Global Korea Scholarship for Graduate Degrees
scholarships.description: Graduate scholarship routes at designated South Korean universities. The government overview lists nationality, age, education and academic requirements; check the current guidelines and embassy or university track for your country and subject.
scholarships.funding_notes: The government overview lists airfare, Korean-language training fees, tuition and monthly allowances. Award terms, eligibility and the availability of each benefit must be checked in the relevant year's guidelines.

scholarships.title: NL Scholarship
scholarships.description: For applicants with non-EEA nationality applying to a full-time bachelor's or master's programme at a participating Dutch institution. Applicants must meet that institution's requirements and must not have a degree from an educational institution in the Netherlands. Check participating institutions and their current deadlines.
scholarships.funding_notes: The official overview states a EUR 5,000 award in the first year and says it is not a full-tuition scholarship. Check the institution's specific terms and remaining costs.

scholarships.title: NUS Research Scholarship
scholarships.description: For eligible research master's and PhD candidates at the National University of Singapore. Selection and application requirements depend on the faculty or school; check your chosen programme. International scholarship holders must meet Graduate Assistantship Programme requirements.
scholarships.funding_notes: NUS lists a full tuition fee waiver and a monthly stipend, with rates varying by degree and citizenship. Check the current award conditions and whether the stipend covers your actual living costs.

scholarships.title: Oxford Clarendon Scholarships - Full-time Graduate Study
scholarships.description: Oxford considers eligible applicants for new full-time master's and DPhil courses who apply by the relevant course funding deadline. Open across nationalities and subjects; selection is competitive. Check the course's December or January deadline and current requirements.
scholarships.funding_notes: Oxford states that Clarendon covers course fees in full and provides a living-cost grant for full-time scholars during the fee-liability period. Continuation charges and other costs can fall outside the award; check the offer and official terms.
